_comment: defaults: what each provider sent before llm_provider.reasoning_effort existed: a level string, or null for send nothing. workers_ai is absent because its client is fixed at low. gemini_thinking_budget: a Gemini model whose id starts with one of model_prefixes takes thinkingBudget instead of thinkingLevel, with these token budgets per level. Source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/openai (section Thinking). The reasons are in docs/architecture.md section 5 and ADR-0018.
